summary: Somerset County steel lookout in Forbes State Forest; register says built before 1924, forest history says 1925; removed 1933; no current site description found.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1933 according to the FFLOS register. No source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Forbes forest history lists the Pondfield and Bald Knob fire towers as constructed this year. The FFLOS register says built before 1924.
Register says the steel tower was removed in 1933.
Registered September 16, 2008, nominated by Henry Isenberg.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says built before 1924; the Forbes forest history says the Bald Knob tower was constructed in 1925. The story reports both dates and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Built date conflicts (before 1924 per register; 1925 per Forbes history); story gives both. No staffing or fire records found on the lookout page, the register, or the forest history. Brief height_m 15.2 (50 ft) left out: the only 50-foot mention (1913) is not named to this site. Brief access 'unknown' not upgraded; no source states the tower site's access. A YouTube title seen in search, 'The Fire Tower Logbook on Bald Knob Recorded a Fire That Never Burned' (youtube.com/watch?v=Kb4Yn6rIaUc), could not be read (no description returned), so it is not used; it may concern a different Bald Knob or this one, and is worth checking.
